subject: Partner paper: pass-through vs. indemnity carveouts — need clarification
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@cloudnest.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia@cloudnest.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Partner paper: pass-through vs. indemnity carveouts — quick question

Hi Ben / team,

Thanks again for the time last week. We've pulled together a draft partner paper for the CloudNest marketplace listing and our legal team flagged a coupling of pass-through liability language with an indemnity carveout that we're hoping to get aligned on quickly.

Quick summary of the issue: in Section 4 (Ordering & Billing) your redline retains a pass-through for marketplace fees, which CloudNest is fine with. But Section 9 (Liability & Indemnity) adds a carveout that would make Redwood indemnify CloudNest for third-party claims tied to distributed billing flows unless the pass-through is explicitly excluded from indemnity scope. Our counsel is nervous that having both clauses, without cross-reference, creates operational ambiguity for audit and settlement.

Can your legal/ops team confirm whether Redwood intends the pass-through fees to remain outside indemnity obligations (i.e., CloudNest bears refund/reconciliation liability)? If so, can we get a short clause we can include that cross-references the pass-through clause and explicitly limits Redwood's indemnity?

I've attached the partner paper with our inline comments (CloudNest_PartnerPaper_v3_redlines.docx).

Best,
Priya
Priya Shah
Head of Partnerships, CloudNest Inc
A: 1201 Market St, San Francisco, CA
T: (415) 555-0198

--Attachment: CloudNest_PartnerPaper_v3_redlines.docx (changes tracked)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@cloudnest.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 11:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner paper: pass-through vs. indemnity carveouts — quick question

Priya — thanks for the clear write-up and the doc. Looping in Laura (Legal) and Karthik (Marketplace ops) to scope the ask and propose language.

Karthik / Laura: can you take a look at Priya's notes in the attached and confirm two things:
- Operational intent: do we expect Redwood to assume refunds / reconciliation liability for pass-through fees or should CloudNest own that?
- Contract language: if we want to keep pass-through fees out of Redwood indemnity, propose 1–2 sentences we can drop into Section 9 that reference Section 4.

I'll hold on responding to their inline redlines until we have a short proposed clause (we'd like to keep the marketplace onboarding timeline intact).

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
--Attachment referenced: CloudNest_PartnerPaper_v3_redlines.docx
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya@cloudnest.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner paper: pass-through vs. indemnity carveouts — proposed wording

Ben / Priya — thanks for the signal. I reviewed the redlines and spoke with Ops. Operationally, CloudNest should continue to own settlement/reconciliation liability for marketplace pass-throughs — Redwood does not intend to accept liability for third-party billing flows that CloudNest controls.

Proposed clean clause to add to Section 9 (Liability & Indemnity), which we suggest cross-reference to Section 4 (Billing):
"Redwood's indemnification obligations under this Agreement shall not extend to any claims, losses, or liabilities arising from marketplace pass-through fees, settlement or billing disputes that are expressly allocated to CloudNest in Section 4 (Ordering & Billing). CloudNest shall be responsible for refunds, chargebacks, and reconciliation of any fees it collects or remits through the marketplace."

A couple of notes:
- We kept the clause narrow to avoid creating unintended carveouts for product defects or API misuse.
- If CloudNest needs Redwood to indemnify for rights-to-use issues tied to third-party billing integrations, we can discuss a scoped mutual indemnity that is limited to Redwood's direct acts.

I've attached a PDF excerpt of Schedule A showing the billing waterfall for clarity (CloudNest_SOW_ScheduleA.pdf). If that looks good, Ben — please confirm and I'll ask Legal to insert the clause and run a final pass.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
--Attachment: CloudNest_SOW_ScheduleA.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@cloudnest.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner paper: pass-through vs. indemnity carveouts — final

Priya — thanks for the fast turnaround and for raising the question. Laura's proposed language matches our ops intent: CloudNest will own settlement/chargeback risk for pass-through marketplace fees. We will not broaden Redwood's indemnity to absorb those.

Next steps:
1) Laura to insert the clause into Section 9 and produce a tracked-change partner paper (ETA EOD Wed).
2) Priya — please confirm you and your counsel are comfortable with that wording; if so we'll route the updated partner paper for signatures.
3) Karthik will review the billing waterfall on Wednesday and confirm any minor operational capture we need in Schedule A (for reporting/holdback).

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
